reports.label: Friday, 13 November 2026
reports.headline: Nifty +0.18% at 25,299.35 Thursday; India October CPI 6.09%; Nvidia CEO exit, US indices −0.4%, Brent $95.82
points: Thu 12 Nov: Nifty +0.18% to 25,299.35, Sensex +0.04% to 81,911.01; NSE breadth 2,377 up, 1,878 down (HDFC Sky).
India's October CPI inflation: 6.09% vs 5.54% in September, above the RBI's 6% upper limit (MoSPI data via ANI, Xinhua).
FII +₹7,831 cr, DII −₹6,331 cr in cash on 12 Nov (NSE provisional, via NiftyTrader and 5paisa).
US Thursday: Dow −0.36%, S&P 500 −0.35%, Nasdaq −0.39% (AP); Nvidia −4.34% after announcing CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.
Brent settled $95.82 (+3.30%) after Indian hours. No Friday-morning GIFT Nifty reading verified.

reports.label: Friday, 6 November 2026
reports.headline: Nifty +2.40%, then Nasdaq -5.52%, Kospi halted, Brent $98.29
points: Nifty closed Thursday at 24,536.60 (+2.40%). GIFT Nifty was 24,421.50 at 07:13 IST, 115.10 points below it (one source).
After India's close, the US fell: Dow -3.44%, S&P 500 -4.36%, Nasdaq -5.52%. CNBC linked it to AI-spending fears after Democrats' win.
Friday in Asia: Kospi opened 8.55% lower at 4,923.47 and trading halted 20 minutes. Nikkei fell about 5% in early trade (AFP).
Thursday cash, provisional: FII +₹14,974.70 crore, DII -₹10,444.50 crore. Brent settled $98.29 (+3.88%, Reuters). Rupee flat at 94.46 (PTI).
Today: Hindalco, Bosch, Voltas listed for Q2 results; US jobs report 7:00 PM IST. Monday: Nifty expiry. Tuesday: holiday.
